options_hindi: प्राथमिक और माध्यमिक विद्यार्थियों से भवन का इंजीनियरिंग नक्शा स्वतंत्र रूप से बनवाना
सुरक्षा के सभी निर्णय केवल विद्यार्थी मतदान से लेना
विद्यार्थियों को प्रवेश-द्वार पर सुरक्षा गार्ड के रूप में नियुक्त करना

questions.question_english: Child safety frameworks emphasize the “Right to Participation” for children in matters concerning their safety. How can a school best implement this?
options_english: By asking primary and secondary students to independently design the engineering and structural blueprint of the building
By leaving all safety decisions to a student vote
By forcing students to act as security guards at the gate
By including student council members in school safety planning, consultations, and awareness activities
questions.explanation_english: By including student council members in the School Safety Committee and soliciting their feedback on safety issues Implementing the child’s Right to Participation involves including student representatives on School Safety Committees and gathering student feedback regarding campus safety. Engaging students allows administrators to identify overlooked hazards, understand student concerns, and foster personal safety awareness. Active participation builds personal responsibility, empowers youth, and strengthens safety cultures across the entire institution.
questions.explanation_hindi: सही उत्तर (D) है: विद्यालय सुरक्षा योजना, परामर्श और जागरूकता गतिविधियों में विद्यार्थी परिषद के सदस्यों को शामिल करना। यह कदम विद्यालय की सुरक्षा-व्यवस्था को व्यवस्थित बनाता है और प्रबंधन, कर्मचारियों, अभिभावकों तथा विद्यार्थियों की जिम्मेदारियों को स्पष्ट करने में मदद करता है।

questions.question_english: To ensure the safety of students with specific severe allergies (e.g., severe peanut allergy), the school administration should ideally:
options_english: Deny admission to such students to avoid risk
Maintain a confidential health record, inform relevant teachers, and have an emergency action plan (like an EpiPen availability) in place
Publicly announce the specific child’s severe medical condition during the daily morning assembly to alert all students, teachers, and visitors
Confiscate all lunchboxes from the entire school
questions.explanation_english: Maintain a confidential health record, inform relevant teachers, and have an emergency action plan (like an EpiPen availability) in place Managing severe student allergies requires maintaining confidential medical records, educating primary educators, and establishing individual emergency response plans, including auto-injector storage where prescribed. Proactive medical management prevents accidental allergen exposure while ensuring rapid treatment for anaphylactic reactions. Medical preparedness safeguards vulnerable students without imposing unnecessary social isolation or compromising student dignity.
questions.explanation_hindi: सही उत्तर (B) है: गोपनीय स्वास्थ्य रिकॉर्ड रखना, संबंधित शिक्षकों को सूचित करना और EpiPen जैसी आपात योजना तैयार रखना। इस उपाय से पहचाने गए जोखिमों को कम करने, आपात स्थिति के लिए तैयारी बढ़ाने और विद्यार्थियों तथा कर्मचारियों की सुरक्षित निकासी/सुरक्षा में मदद मिलती है।

questions.question_english: As per standard surveillance guidelines, who should have authorized access to view the live feed and recorded footage of the school’s CCTV cameras?
options_english: All parents through a public web link
Only the Head of the Institution or specifically authorized security personnel under strict confidentiality
Any teaching staff member who wishes to monitor classroom activities remotely from the teachers’ staff room during non-teaching hours

questions.explanation_english: Only the Head of the Institution or specifically authorized security personnel under strict confidentiality Access to live surveillance feeds and recorded video footage must be strictly restricted to authorized institutional heads and security officers. Limiting system access prevents video misuse, protects student privacy, and maintains strict data confidentiality. Maintaining controlled surveillance management guarantees that video records are accessed purely for official safety monitoring, internal investigations, or legal evidence procedures.

questions.question_english: In the context of hazard identification within an SDMP, a chemical factory situated 500 meters from the school premises would be classified as what type of hazard?

Internal non-structural or environmental operational hazard
Internal structural hazard

questions.explanation_english: External anthropogenic (human-made) hazard Industrial facilities, chemical processing plants, and fuel depots situated near educational institutions represent external anthropogenic hazards. These human-made installations present potential off-site risks, including industrial explosions, toxic gas leaks, and chemical fires. Hazard mapping frameworks require identifying external industrial risks to develop specialized emergency evacuation plans and chemical containment protocols for the school.

questions.question_english: In the context of child safety, if a school administration fails to act upon a severe bullying complaint, the NCPCR can take suo-motu cognizance of the matter. What does “suo-motu” mean in this context?
options_english: Taking action on its own motion without a formal complaint being filed
Acting only upon a written directive from the Ministry
Acting based on an anonymous email or unverified letter received from an external foreign entity
Taking action only after a police FIR is registered
questions.explanation_english: Taking action on its own motion without a formal complaint being filed Suo-motu jurisdiction empowers a statutory body to initiate legal inquiries or administrative proceedings independently without waiting for a formal victim complaint.
